text:
maria: heads-up — saw a perf regression on sm99 for the int4 kernel pick path when seqlen spikes past ~300. traces point at repeated kernel flips + KV cache churn :grimacing:

devon: ugh. is it the kernel selector hysteresis or the seqlen bucket boundaries? or both?

maria: looks like hysteresis is too tight. selector flips from int4->fp8->int4 within a single session when prefix len + generated tokens > 320. also kvcache gets rebuilt and increases latency. attached profiler link: https://perf.internal/runs/8932 (cpu/gpu timelines) :eyes:

perfbot: profiling job 8932 completed — 95th p99 latency +14% for int4 path on sm99 compared to baseline (sm88). KV cache invalidations increased by 11%.

rowan: can you paste the kernel pick logs? curious about weights and tie-breaks.

maria: here are the relevant lines from the selector log:

```
[2026-02-11T14:21:03Z] seqlen=340 prefer=int4 score=0.72
[2026-02-11T14:21:03Z] seqlen=341 prefer=fp8 score=0.71 hysteresis_drop=0.02
[2026-02-11T14:21:03Z] seqlen=342 prefer=int4 score=0.705 hysteresis_gain=0.005
[2026-02-11T14:21:03Z] kernel_swap int4->fp8 due_to=score_delta
```

maria: selector is using a rolling score with small hysteresis; tiny noise makes it oscillate. plus int4 path triggers a different KV chunking that causes more mem copies on sm99.

sachin: two things to try: 1) widen hysteresis window (increase hysteresis alpha from 0.01 to 0.04) so small score jitter doesn't flip, 2) adjust seqlen buckets to bias longer sequences to fp8 by default (move bucket boundary from 256->320).

devon: also consider proactive KV warmup for predicted longer tails. if we prefetch first 64 kv entries into GPU cache once seqlen>200 we avoid repeated rebuilds. that was cheap in previous archs.

rowan: agree. for SM99 memory layout, int4 micro-kernel has a weird alignment that makes KV chunk copies 10% slower — so the cost-model should add a per-arch penalty to int4 on sm99. we should encode per-arch penalty table in the autotune config.

maria: proposed autotune patch (quick pseudo-config):

```
{"autotune_v2": {
  "per_arch_penalty": {"sm99": {"int4": 0.12, "int8": 0.02, "fp8": 0.0}},
  "hysteresis_alpha": 0.04,
  "seqlen_buckets": [64,128,320,512],
  "kvcache_warmup_prefix": 64,
  "batching_threshold_ms": 6
}}
```

maria: note batching_threshold_ms = 6 to avoid microscopic batching that increases latency skew when kernel flips.

sachin: sounds reasonable. can we run a small AB with canary rollout to 10% traffic for 2h? include p99, p50, kv-invalidations, and token-cost metrics.

devon: i'll schedule the canary. also add a debug flag to log kernel pick decisions at higher granularity for a short window so we can validate no oscillations.

rowan: also add a safety fallback: if kernel swapped >3 times in 60s for a session, pin to the more stable kernel for the next 5k tokens. prevents thrash.

maria: good idea. i'll open a tiny PR with config + selector change + fallback. will cc eng-ml and perf for review.

devon: thx — please add the perfbot job id in PR so we can correlate metrics.

perfbot: scheduled canary run 8971 (10% traffic) — will report after 2h.

maria: thanks all. action items: maria PR, devon launch canary, sachin watch metrics + run a quick microbench for KV copy cost on sm99. will reconvene after perfbot summary. :thumbsup:
